AAD: Rash 101 in adults — when to seek medical treatment

education.title: Choose gentle cleansing
education.body: Consider a gentle, fragrance-free cleanser. Use enough to clean without building a thick lather. Fragrance-free labeling does not guarantee that you will tolerate a product.

education.title: Keep washing warm and short
education.body: Keep baths and showers short, about 5–10 minutes, using warm rather than hot water. Gently pat skin dry instead of rubbing.

education.title: Moisturize while skin is damp
education.body: Apply moisturizer while your skin is still damp after washing. Creams or ointments are general options for dry-feeling skin; a product's ingredients do not guarantee personal tolerance.

emergency.title: Get emergency help now
emergency.body: Use your local emergency number now — 911 in the United States. Do not wait for a skin photo, cosmetic score, or product check. This app cannot assess an emergency.

review.title: Seek medical evaluation
review.body: A clinician should assess the concern you reported. A cosmetic scan or product label cannot determine the cause. Persistent dryness despite gentle care, or burning or stinging from applied products, also warrants clinician advice.

unknown.title: Some information is still unknown
unknown.body: Some warning-sign answers are missing or uncertain. This is not medical clearance. You can review general information and seek medical advice if concerned. A cosmetic score cannot resolve these unanswered questions.

unsupported.title: Choose the supported concern
unsupported.body: This guide provides educational information for dry-feeling skin. Choose that concern to continue, or consult a qualified clinician for a medical concern. This app cannot diagnose another condition.
